description.value:
Ability Scores: DEX, CON, INT

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.suns-of-rubi-core.feats.FeatToughOrigin1]{Tough}

Skill Proficiencies: Choose 2 from INS, INV, PLT, TEC

Feature: Deep-Space Acclimation

Having spent countless months in the cold corridors of starships, deep-space mining platforms, and low-gravity orbital stations, you are intimately familiar with vacuum hazards. You suffer no penalties to balance or coordination in zero-gravity or high-G environments. You can easily detect micro-meteorite hull stress, failing atmospheric scrubbers, and subtle vacuum pressure drops before station sensors register a breach. In addition, void-dock workers and station engineers welcome you as a fellow void-dog, sharing docking berths and scrap alloys at fair rates.

Roleplay Characteristics

Personality Traits

d6 Trait
1I instinctively check the seal on my pressure collar and air gauge several times an hour.
2I move with the fluid, cautious grace of someone used to zero-gravity maneuvering.
3Planetary gravity fields feel oppressive, heavy, and unnatural to my spine and legs.
4I prefer the constant hum of life-support scrubbers to the unsettling silence of nature.
5I have a practical repair fix for every malfunctioning hydraulic line or oxygen valve.
6I treat every breath of pressurized air as a precious commodity that shouldn't be wasted on chatter.

Ideals

d6 Trait
1Self-Reliance. In the void of space, a single mistake will vent you into vacuum; rely on your own competence. (Neutral)
2Community. A ship's crew is a single organism; if the hull breaches, everyone drowns in the void together. (Good)
3Order. Safety protocols, airlock checks, and maintenance schedules must be followed religiously. (Lawful)
4Curiosity. The uncharted deep darkness between star systems holds mysteries we must unlock. (Chaotic)
5Ruthlessness. Life support reserves are finite; dead weight must be jettisoned when survival is on the line. (Evil)
6Endurance. Space is cold and indifferent, but the human will to explore is indestructible. (Any)

Bonds

d6 Trait
1I survived a catastrophic decompression event that destroyed my previous hauler; I owe my life to its captain.
2My customized EVA suit has kept me alive through solar flares and vacuum leaks; it is my armor and life.
3I have a deep-space charting datapad detailing unknown navigational corridors through the rim.
4My family has worked the orbital orbital refineries for four generations without ever walking on a planet.
5I am saving credits to buy an independent mining scout and strike rich in the deep asteroid belts.
6I carry a piece of hull debris from a legendary derelict vessel I explored in deep space.

Flaws

d6 Trait
1I feel intense agoraphobia under open planetary skies with no ceilings or bulkheads.
2I am overly protective of fresh water, oxygen reserves, and battery power, hoarding resources obsessively.
3I judge planet-dwellers as soft, wasteful, and ignorant of cosmic reality.
4I am slow to trust ground-pounders who don't know how to operate an emergency vacuum patch kit.
5My emotional responses are flat and muted from years of isolation in long-haul shipping.
6I get irritable and anxious when sub-light engines shut down and artificial gravity fluctuates.

advancement.title: Ability Score Improvement
advancement.hint: Your background allows you to increase your DEX, CON, INT scores: increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

advancement.title: Skill Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Choose 2 skills from: ins, inv, plt, tec.

advancement.title: Tool Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Your background grants you tool proficiency options.

advancement.title: Origin Feat
advancement.hint: Your background grants you the Tough origin feat.
